facts.fact: The BCEAO Instruction of 23 January 2024 on payment services in the UMOA is the rule under which payment institutions are licensed; the article describes it as the framework now applying in Senegal.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction of 23 January 2024 on payment services in the UMOA

facts.fact: The article says that at end-February 2026 the BCEAO counted 11 licensed payment institutions in Senegal, defined by the 2024 Instruction as legal persons distinct from banks, e-money institutions and microfinance institutions, among them Flutterwave Senegal and Djamo Senegal.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction of 23 January 2024 on payment services in the UMOA

facts.fact: The BCEAO postponed to 30 September 2026 the deadline for banks, e-money institutions and payment institutions to open their services on PI-SPI.
facts.system: BCEAO deadline of 30 September 2026 for connection to PI-SPI

systems.tiers: banks, e-money institutions, microfinance institutions, payment institutions
